name: What preparation do I need to do before cabinet installers arrive?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do before cabinet installers arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the installers arrive, please ensure that the work area is clear of furniture, appliances, and personal belongings. Walls should be prepared, and any necessary plumbing or electrical work should be completed beforehand. This helps our team to work efficiently and safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the work area of furniture and belongings; ensure walls are prepared and plumbing/electrical work is complete.
